findings.title: Monolithic AkshareService with excessive responsibilities
findings.description: AkshareService (1200+ lines) handles catalog management, job scheduling, HTTP requests, data parsing, data persistence, and status tracking. This violates Single Responsibility Principle and makes the service difficult to test, modify, and extend.
findings.suggested_issue: Extract responsibilities into separate services: AkshareCatalogService (catalog management), AkshareSchedulerService (job scheduling), AkshareParserService (data parsing), AkshareDataPointRepository (persistence). Keep AkshareService as a facade coordinating these services.

findings.title: Hardcoded parser type switch statement limits extensibility
findings.description: The parsePayload method uses a switch statement with hardcoded parser types ('latest', 'timeseries', 'macro', 'yearMonth', 'yieldCurve'). Adding new data sources requires modifying this core method, violating Open/Closed Principle.
findings.suggested_issue: Implement a ParserRegistry pattern with pluggable parser classes. Each parser type should implement an IDataParser interface. Register parsers at module initialization, allowing new parsers to be added without modifying core service code.

findings.title: Tight coupling between GraphQL resolver and AkshareService
findings.description: EconomicDataResolver directly depends on AkshareService and performs inline data transformation (mapping points to GraphQL models). This couples the presentation layer to the data access layer and duplicates transformation logic.
findings.snippet:

  unit: point.unit,
  sourceField: point.sourceField,
  dataType: point.dataType,
  item: {
    slug: point.item.slug,
    displayName: point.item.displayName,
findings.suggested_issue: Introduce a dedicated EconomicDataMapper class to handle transformations between domain models and GraphQL DTOs. This separates concerns and makes transformation logic reusable and testable.

findings.title: Duplicated data transformation logic across resolver methods
findings.description: The same item transformation pattern (slug, displayName, groupLabel, defaultUnit, metadata) is repeated in getEconomicData, economicDataFetchConfigs, and updateEconomicDataFetchConfig methods.
findings.snippet:
item: {
  slug: point.item.slug,
  displayName: point.item.displayName,
  groupLabel: point.item.groupLabel ?? undefined,
  defaultUnit: point.item.defaultUnit ?? null,
  metadata: (point.item.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null) ?? null
}
findings.suggested_issue: Extract the item transformation into a shared helper function or mapper method. Create a toEconomicDataItemModel(item) function that can be reused across all resolver methods.

findings.title: Frontend hook duplicates backend data grouping logic
findings.description: useEconomicData hook reimplements data grouping and series organization logic that conceptually belongs to the backend. The frontend should receive pre-grouped data rather than raw points requiring client-side aggregation.
findings.suggested_issue: Consider adding a GraphQL query that returns pre-grouped series data from the backend. This reduces client-side computation, ensures consistent grouping logic, and improves performance for large datasets.

findings.title: Hardcoded Chinese field names in parser definitions
findings.description: Parser configurations use hardcoded Chinese field names ('开盘价', '收盘价', '最高价', '最低价', '日期'). This creates implicit coupling to specific data source formats and makes internationalization difficult.
findings.snippet:
const createOhlcFields = (unit: string): AkshareDataFieldConfig[] => [
  { field: "开盘价", label: "开盘价", unit, dataType: EconomicDataValueType.price },
  { field: "最高价", label: "最高价", unit, dataType: EconomicDataValueType.price },
findings.suggested_issue: Create a field mapping layer that translates source-specific field names to canonical internal names. Store mappings in configuration rather than code, allowing field name changes without code modifications.

findings.title: Frontend series utilities duplicate field resolution logic
findings.description: The series.ts utility file reimplements field resolution logic (resolveFieldKey) that mirrors backend parser field configurations. Changes to backend field naming require corresponding frontend updates.
findings.suggested_issue: Move field resolution logic to the backend and expose resolved field keys in the GraphQL response. The frontend should receive data with consistent, resolved field identifiers rather than performing resolution client-side.

findings.title: Hardcoded OHLC field names in getCandlestickSeries
findings.description: getCandlestickSeries function hardcodes both English and Chinese field name variants ('open'/'开盘价', 'close'/'收盘价', etc.). This creates maintenance burden when field naming conventions change.
findings.suggested_issue: Define canonical OHLC field names in a shared constants file. Backend should normalize field names to canonical form before sending to frontend, eliminating the need for multi-language fallback resolution.

findings.title: Force-sync slug sets indicate schema evolution issues
findings.description: The service maintains hardcoded sets (forceParserSyncSlugs, forceDefaultParamsSyncSlugs) to override normal merge behavior for specific data items. This indicates schema migration issues and creates hidden dependencies.
findings.snippet:
private readonly forceParserSyncSlugs = new Set<string>(["global_epu_index", "china_fx_gold_reserves", "macro_fx_sentiment"]);
private readonly forceDefaultParamsSyncSlugs = new Set<string>(["macro_fx_sentiment", "market_sentiment_usdx"]);
findings.suggested_issue: Implement a proper schema versioning system for data item definitions. Use database migrations or version flags in definitions to handle schema evolution cleanly, rather than hardcoded override lists.

findings.title: Inconsistent DataPoint interface definitions across layers
findings.description: DataPoint interfaces are defined separately in multiple files (market-pulse.tsx, global-sentiment-trend.tsx, useEconomicData.ts) with slight variations. This creates type inconsistency and maintenance overhead.
findings.suggested_issue: Create a shared types file (e.g., @/types/economic-data.ts) with canonical DataPoint and related interfaces. Import these types across all components to ensure consistency and single source of truth.

findings.title: AdminAkshareController mixes HTTP concerns with business logic
findings.description: AdminAkshareController contains business logic for upgrade watching, status polling, and audit logging alongside HTTP handling. The watchUpgradeCompletion method (100+ lines) should be extracted to a service.
findings.suggested_issue: Extract upgrade monitoring logic into a dedicated AkshareUpgradeService. The controller should only handle HTTP request/response mapping, delegating business logic to the service layer.

findings.title: Large static definitions array in akshare.definitions.ts
findings.description: AKSHARE_DATA_DEFINITIONS is a large static array (500+ lines) that grows with each new data source. This monolithic approach makes it difficult to manage, test, and version individual definitions.
findings.snippet:
export const AKSHARE_DATA_DEFINITIONS: AkshareDataItemDefinition[] = [

    id: "gold-futures-realtime",
    slug: "gold_futures_realtime",
findings.suggested_issue: Split definitions into category-based files (e.g., futures.definitions.ts, bonds.definitions.ts, macro.definitions.ts). Use a registry pattern to aggregate definitions at runtime, improving organization and enabling per-category testing.
